# The Credit People

> > The Credit People provides comprehensive credit repair guidance, debt collection defense strategies, and wage garnishment protection resources for consumers navigating financial challenges.

The Credit People offers expert advice on credit score recovery, wage garnishment laws, debt collection rights, and account protection. Content covers federal regulations (FCRA, IRS rules), state-specific laws (Georgia, California), and institutional policies (Capital One, American Express, Chime) to help consumers resolve financial disputes and rebuild credit.

## Key Topics

- wage garnishment
- credit repair
- debt collection
- credit score impact
- FCRA disputes
- bank account garnishment
- disposable income limits
- court judgment
- charge-off debt
- mortgage default
- child support garnishment
- consumer rights
- garnishment refunds
- credit report errors
- account freeze protection

## Wage Garnishment & Recovery

- [Maximum Wage Garnishment: How Much Can Legally Be Taken From Pay?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/maximum-wage-garnishment-limits): Federal wage garnishment limits on disposable income and child support
- [How Much of Your Paycheck Can Student Loans Garnish (Legally)?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/student-loan-wage-garnishment-amount): Federal & private student loan garnishment limits on disposable income
- [How Fast Can You Get Garnished Wages Back? (2-16 Weeks Guide)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/garnished-wages-recovery-time): Guide to wage garnishment refund timelines with IRS & creditor processes
- [Can Child Support Be Garnished Without Court Order? (Legal Facts)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/child-support-garnishment-without-court-order): Child support wage withholding under 42 U.S.C. §666 federal law
- [Overpaid Your Garnishment? What Happens Next (Refund or Not?)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/overpaid-garnishment-what-happens): Wage garnishment overpayment refund process and payroll error recovery

## Bank Account & Asset Protection

- [How Long Does Bank Account Garnishment Take (Really)?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/garnish-bank-account-timeline): Bank garnishment timeline guide from court judgment to account freeze
- [Can Cash App Be Garnished? What to Expect If Creditors Win (2024)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/cash-app-garnishment-process-explained): Cash App garnishment via Sutton Bank/Lincoln Savings Bank court orders
- [How Do You Legally Find Where Someone Banks for Garnishment?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/find-bank-account-for-garnishment): Legal discovery methods for locating debtor bank accounts via subpoena
- [Can My Stimulus Check Be Garnished? (Third Check Rules Explained)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/stimulus-check-garnishment-determination): IRS stimulus check garnishment rules by state (California, New York)
- [Chime Closed Account Letter: What Does It Mean & What Should You Do?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/chime-closed-account-letter-meaning-actions): Chime account closure guide covering frozen funds and recovery steps

## Credit Repair & Dispute Resolution

- [Charged Off as Bad Debt? How FCRA Disputes Can Fix Credit Errors](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/charged-off-as-bad-debt-when-disputed-info-meets-fcra-standards): FCRA dispute process for charge-offs with Equifax/Experian per FTC rules
- [Are Charged-Off Debts Collectible? What Happens After Charge-Off?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/are-charged-off-debts-still-collectible-what-really-happens-next): Charged-off debt collection rights and statute of limitations guide
- [Why Did My Credit Score Drop 17 Points? (Top Causes Explained)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/why-did-my-credit-score-drop-17-points): Credit score drop troubleshooting using AnnualCreditReport.com data
- [Can You Get a New Capital One Card After a Charge-Off? (How/When)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/can-you-get-another-capital-one-card-after-a-charge-off): Capital One reapplication guide after charge-off and credit rebuilding
- [Amex Financial Review (Closed Account): What Actually Happens?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/amex-financial-review-closed-account-process): American Express financial review process and Membership Rewards impact

## Mortgage & Foreclosure Prevention

- [60 Days Late on Mortgage? (Fees, Credit Impact, Foreclosure Risk)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/60-days-late-mortgage-what-happens-next): Mortgage delinquency consequences at 60 days with foreclosure timeline
- [Georgia Foreclosure: How Many Missed Payments Before Losing Home?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/georgia-foreclosure-missed-payments-home-loss): Georgia foreclosure timeline guide covering 120-day rule and prevention
- [How Soon After a Short Sale Can You Get a VA Loan? (2-Year Rule)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/va-loan-waiting-period-short-sale): VA loan eligibility timeline after short sale with entitlement rules

## Payment & Late Fee Issues

- [Can I Be a Week Late on My Car Payment? (Fees, Credit Impact)](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/week-late-car-payment-consequences): Auto loan grace period guide covering late fees and credit score impact
- [Can Contractors Charge Interest on Late Payments (Legally)?](https://www.thecreditpeople.com/credit/contractors-charge-interest-late-payment): Contract law guide on late payment interest and usury rate limits
